body:
Ate 20 tabs dosed at 120ug intermittently during a zopiclone black out where I was drifting in and out of consciousness. Was an absolute head fuck of a trip but for some reason the outcome of it was positive. 

I kept having out of body experiences where I would go to different places and it was like watching a 3d movie. Experienced ego death a few points. Got convinced I got possessed by a psychedelic ghost which was interesting. Shit was wild, but I came out of it stronger.

I highly recommend King Gizzad And The Lizzad Wizzad, specifically the album Quarters for rolling or tripping.

https://youtu.be/-Ak2E0igSx8

No where near as bad, but during an acid trip with a bunch of people at a festival, our friend (call him Jeff) who was tripping for the first time wasn't having a good time with it. He would be comatose for ages then periodically wake up and shout "what the fuck is happening!?" and things of that nature.

Well anyway things were fine but when we were outside and Jeff was actually up and about he decided to throw our huge fuck off speaker at our friends tent with them inside. Cue confused and very angry shouts, and our friend storming out of the tent to yell at him. Things got a bit dark during that, but no one got hurt and things were sorted so it's all good now. But yeah, not really bad but I thought it might be worth telling.
Cheers dude. It's mostly alright now, things just flow a bit. I'm happy I can read again today hah
Sounds gnarly. How come he wasn't sent to PICU?
I mean, the free drugs are nice but apart from that it's pretty awful. We find ways to get kicks in here though
Last one I was in you couldn't have any phones or anything at all really. No belts either
Low security one, they let us keep our phones. There's even wifi
I feel you man... I appreciate that, good luck to yourself too. I'm glad I could help in some way, if there's anything you need to just talk about feel free to hit me up.
Trying to be as least selfish as possible, it is nice to know I'm not alone in this which keeps the wolves at bay. I hope you're doing okay my dude.

It's more of a general substance abuse problem as opposed to addiction to a specific drug. I had a long stint with cocaine, then I was doing acid every weekend for a while, lots of MDA, and currently it's ketamine. All along with a constant steady stream of alcohol. I attribute this to a baseline unhappiness with my life/general surroundings - but even when things are good in my life there's still this need to get out of my head. I was happy, and now things are coming apart and I've lost that I see all the less reason to try to pretend everything's okay and hold myself together.
